output.review_comment: The PR correctly fixes all failing tests with legitimate, well-implemented rules: (1) preserving mixed-case words like "iPhone", (2) ensuring the last word is always capitalized even if it's a small word, and (3) capitalizing the first word after a colon for subtitles. The docstring is appropriately updated to document the colon-handling feature. All code changes are semantically sound with no test-specific hacks—these are genuine rules that a title casing function should follow.
